svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · not-synced · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) — the PICPLACE section of a project's detail screen (iOS project-detail.*) and of the Mac Gallery item inspector: whether this project has a copy on the user's PicPlace account, and the one action that state offers. The first six states (2026-09-14), one file each: signed-out (no PicPlace account on this device), not-synced (never uploaded), changes (edited since the last sync), syncing (upload in flight — a progress bar in LL.amber on LL.controlFill, files and bytes done of total), synced (a copy is on the server: when, how much, and which OTHER devices report holding a copy — the server's presence records), failed (the last attempt's error in the caption; the write claim held by another device is the common one). The glyph column speaks the holdings pill's language (plan §16, signed off 2026-09-26 — glyph(for:size:) → statusGlyph(for:) → StatusGlyphView at 0.8 × the column, light palette, each symbol knocked out of its cloud in white): synced and changes wear the pill's rest cloud, the neutral ✓ checkmark.icloud.fill (#48484A) — never green, which now means only 'on this device'; not-synced the neutral ↑ icloud.and.arrow.up.fill; syncing and an upload job's run the amber ↑ (LL.accent #C36A00 on a light card); an upload PicPlace is still reading back the amber ↻ arrow.clockwise.icloud.fill (checking); failed, a conflict and a stopped upload job the red ! exclamationmark.icloud.fill (#D70015 — red, not the old system orange beside the amber); a paused, Wi-Fi-held or interrupted upload job the paused cloud (icloud.fill with pause bars knocked out); a preview the grey camera.fill (#AEAEB2 — its originals on PicPlace, not here); signed-out and not-connected icloud.slash in secondary. Demo data: the 341-file, 4.9 MB photo project the server work was verified with, an iPad Air as the other device. Later states: uploading and the four held upload-job states (2026-09-24, phone), checking and preview-only (2026-09-26, phone). 2026-09-26, this file: the glyph was the secondary icloud outline; it is now the neutral ↑ icloud.and.arrow.up.fill — something here is not on PicPlace yet. Nothing else in the card changed.
